what: Pure-play IBM i / AS400 modernization. Profound UI converts RPG-to-web.
techStack: IBM i (V5R4+), RPG/RPG-Free, Profound UI for web modernization, Node.js on IBM i
dealsInFlight: Mid-market IBM i shops modernizing green-screen apps to web/mobile
decisionMakers: Founder Alex Roytman is publicly active; tech integration leads handle tool decisions
alreadyUsing: Profound UI, Profound.js, IBM i tooling
competition: ARCAD, Fresche Solutions, Looksoftware (now part of Rocket)
bio: Profound Logic is a small, accessible IBM i specialty shop. The Director of AS400 Integration is almost certainly an RPG veteran who wrote green-screen apps before the web existed. Loves tech that bolts cleanly onto Profound UI. Will probe you on IBM i version compatibility, RPG-IV vs RPG-Free, ILE handling. If you can't speak that language, the call ends fast — but if you can, you're talking to a real engineer, not a procurement filter.

abc.a: Your consultants do schema discovery by hand before they touch the actual UI conversion.
abc.b: Reveal the 13-second AST map on a customer's RPG copybook.
abc.c: 20-min briefing with Director of AS400 Integration. Tool-stack partnership.
